items.label: Unique Design
items.value: The spiral design expands in seconds—no tools needed! Secure buckle at the base lock the trellis firmly in place, keeping your climbing plants upright even in strong winds.

items.label: Reliable Material
items.value: Crafted from heavy-duty, powder-coated steel, our garden trellis resists rust 3X longer than cheap plastic supports. Thrives in rain, snow, or scorching sun—guaranteed for years!

items.label: Size Information
items.value: The widest diameter of the plant trellis is about 12.2 inches and the height can be stretched up to 73 inches. You can adjust its height to accommodate a variety of plants and flowers according to your needs,such as cucumbers, tomatoes, morning glories, etc.

items.label: Easy to Store
items.value: Climbing plant trellis are very easy to store. Unlike bulky wooden trellises, ours collapses into a slim disk—toss it in a shed or even a drawer! Zero hassle, zero clutter.

items.label: Premium Service
items.value: We take the customer buying experience very seriously. If you have any questions about our garden trellis for climbing plants, please feel free to contact us and we will be happy to assist you.
